publisher: ATTOM (U.S. Foreclosure Market Report press releases); state legislatures (statute text)
vintage: ATTOM Q2 2025, Q3 2025 and Q2 2026 releases; statutes in force Oct 23, 2026
table: Average days to complete a foreclosure (national and the five longest and five shortest states each quarter); foreclosure notice and redemption periods read from statute text
title: Foreclosure timelines: published averages and statute reads, Oct 23, 2026 pass
universe: Residential properties completing foreclosure in the quarter (ATTOM); owner-occupied mortgages (statutes)
geography: Nation and named states, keyed by postal code
limits: Statute reads are the law in force on the game's opening day, January 20, 2025 (inForceOnOpening). ATTOM publishes per-state averages only for its five longest and five shortest states each quarter, so 42 of 56 places have no published average of their own and take the national figure. A state's figure is the latest of these three quarters that names it. Statute reads cover the fields listed; the rest of foreclosure.json still comes from secondary summaries (data/research/housing/foreclosure-steps-2026.json).

spread.unit: days from first public notice to completed foreclosure
spread.basis: national average in the three quarters read

quotes: Properties foreclosed in Q2 2026 had been in the foreclosure process for an average of 563 days, the lowest level since 2013.

States with the longest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q2 2026 were Louisiana (3,491 days); Hawaii (2,293 days); New York (2,007 days); Connecticut (1,626 days); and Nevada (1,507 days).

States with the shortest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q2 2026 were Texas (155 days); New Hampshire (157 days); Wyoming (173 days); West Virginia (196 days); and Alaska (199 days).
Properties foreclosed in Q3 2025 had been in the foreclosure process for an average of 608 days.

States with the longest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q3 2025 were Louisiana (3,632 days); Nevada (2,667 days); Rhode Island (1,929 days); New York (1,867 days); and Hawaii (1,710 days).

States with the shortest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q3 2025 were West Virginia (135 days); Texas (154 days); Virginia (160 days); Wyoming (165 days); and Montana (174 days).
Properties foreclosed in Q2 2025 had been in the foreclosure process an average of 645 days.

States with the longest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q2 2025 were Louisiana (3,612 days); Hawaii (2,746 days); Nevada (1,974 days); New York (1,927 days); and Connecticut (1,874 days).

States with the shortest average foreclosure timelines for homes foreclosed in Q2 2025 were Wyoming (125 days); Texas (135 days); New Hampshire (149 days); Montana (154 days); and Minnesota (162 days).
